enemy-039-abomination.designLock: Abomination is the retained Tantalus profile name for a PROJECT_ADAPTATION derived from the Aliens: Fireteam Elite Pathogen Brute, never the AVP Predalien homonym and never a promise of a pixel-exact licensed reconstruction. One very broad, low, heavy pathogen-mutated xenomorph with a small recessed head, exactly two legs and exactly two hypertrophied arms ending in two huge anatomical fist-like growths. Pale gray-ivory infected flesh, restrained dark crusting and stable organic asymmetry; strong rather than sickly, with no carried weapon, armor, clothing, tail, Yautja mandibles or dreadlocks. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. Locomotion is a grounded heavy bipedal/knuckle-supported trudge; attack is a committed two-growth ground slam with anticipation, impact, follow-through and recovery, never the queue's generic claw or inner-jaw strike. The shockwave is a gameplay event and is not painted as scenery or a detached effect on the source board. Preserve the same head, shoulder masses, growth diameters, limb count, asymmetry and scale across all clips. Use the V56 project sheet only for Tantalus palette, broad silhouette, grounding and motion continuity; do not copy it frame-for-frame. No extra limb, merged arm, xenomorph dome, dorsal cannon, biomechanical shell, projectile, crop, cell contact or official bitmap reuse.

topology.rule: Each hypertrophied arm remains continuously traceable from shoulder to elbow to one terminal fist-like growth. Growths may compress on impact but never split, detach, swap sides, become held weapons or spawn extra digits/limbs.

referenceLock.silhouette: Very broad and low, with a small head recessed between massive shoulders, compact central torso, powerful legs and two oversized forward arm-growth masses.
referenceLock.material: Pale gray-ivory organic pathogen flesh with restrained bruised beige, cool pink and dark crusted seams. Asymmetry is stable and anatomical; the creature reads powerful, not emaciated or decomposed.
referenceLock.facing: Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay side view in all 32 future poses.

scale.gameplayRole: Large low brute using the existing crusher-large gameplay class.
scale.rigidLandmark: Measure the same anatomical seam-to-seam diameter on the less-occluded fist growth and cross-check the cranial chord from jaw tip to rear skull root on at least two comparable poses per clip.
scale.forbiddenMetric: Never derive inter-clip scale from total arm reach, shockwave/VFX extent, pose bounding box or corpse width.

rootAndGround.pivotStatus: queue precedent only; requires manual physical-root review after generation
rootAndGround.bodyRoot: Project the pelvis/central body mass to the support plane; a planted fist is a contact point, not the body root.
rootAndGround.livePoses: At least one foot and the loaded rear support remain physically credible. Knuckle support may share load during the trudge without turning the creature into a four-legged animal.
rootAndGround.attack: The rearward body support stays braced through the double-growth slam; impact does not move or enlarge the hitbox.
rootAndGround.death: The terminal anchor lies beneath the collapsed torso mass, never beneath the farthest growth tip.

sourceContract.background: true transparent RGBA or perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF
sourceContract.cellIsolation: Exactly one complete creature per nominal cell; no body, growth, effect or fragment touches or crosses a cell boundary.
sourceContract.identityScale: One common anatomy and source scale across idle, move, attack and death; no automatic per-pose correction.

move.rule: Heavy grounded trudge with optional knuckle support; no agile Drone sprint, full quadrupedal gallop or cell-to-cell translation.

attack.rule: Body mechanics communicate the damaging ground pound. No painted floor, shockwave ring, projectile, claw combo, tail strike or inner-jaw piston.

death.rule: One irreversible collapse with the complete body retained; no explosion, dissolution, detached growth or recovery.

prohibitions: No AVP Predalien identity, Yautja dreadlocks, mandibles, trophy gear or Predator technology.
No tail, Queen crest, long Drone dome, dorsal cannon, biomechanical armor or carried weapon.
No extra, missing, fused, branched or detached limb and no mismatch between the two fist-growth identities.
No generic inner-jaw/claw attack replacing the two-growth ground slam.
No painted shockwave, floor, cast shadow, scenery, text, logo, UI, watermark or checkerboard.
No left-facing pose, perspective turn, crop, cell contact, cross-cell fragment or copied official/licensed bitmap.
